title: Retail Store Manager
summary: A retail store manager runs one shop and is answerable for its sales, profit, stock and customer service. They lead the store team, plan staff rosters, keep displays to brand standards and report to an area or cluster manager.
dailyDuties: Review yesterday's sales against target and set today's goals
Brief the team and plan the staff roster
Check displays, planograms and store hygiene
Run stock audits and follow up on replenishment
Handle escalated customer issues on the floor
Train new staff on product and service standards

skills.expectation: Hit monthly store sales targets and track conversion, ATV and UPT
Own the store P&L and control payroll, rent-linked costs and other expenses
Keep displays, planograms and the store look to brand guidelines
Roster and train store staff to match footfall and the budget
Run stock audits and replenishment and keep shrinkage low
Keep service standards high and act on mystery shopper and NPS results
Read daily sales reports and keep store MIS in Excel
Hire, coach and lead a store team
Oversee POS billing, cash handling and store opening and closing
Coach staff to add-on sell and lift basket size
Handle escalated customer complaints on the floor
Plan monthly targets and staffing from sales trends
Brief the team daily and report to the area manager
